data.one_liner: Widget that displays differences between two texts using RichText
data.what_it_does: PrettyDiffText compares two strings and renders the added, deleted, and unchanged parts with distinct styles. It uses diff-match-patch under the hood and exposes many customization options.
use_when: You need a visual diff of two text snippets in a Flutter UI
You want to highlight changes in a document or code review
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution that works on all platforms
avoid_when: You need to diff very large texts or streams of data
You require real‑time diff updates with high performance
You are building a non‑textual diff (e.g., JSON or binary)
strengths: Highly customizable styles and cleanup options
weaknesses: No built‑in performance tuning for large inputs
No support for diffing structured data
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
